notes:
RECENT: mid-market product team focused on improving discovery/relevance for their core product catalog. Head of Search (Maya Patel) on call. Interested in Redwood's reranking endpoints — wants both online rescore of top-k candidate lists and an offline scoring path for nightly re-ranks and experiments.

Summary of needs:
- Workload: reranking primary (rescore top-100 candidates), secondary: embeddings for candidate retrieval and offline evals.
- Eval sets: will provide ~11k human-labeled queries + click logs for relevance tuning.
- Targets: p95 latency < 60ms for online rerank; peak throughput for A/B experiments ~300 qps (batched); offline nightly scoring of ~10M rows without breaking budget.
- Quality/regressions: needs easy A/Bing and deterministic scoring, integration with Redwood Optimize for regression alerts.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration; prefer US data residency.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need reranker output to be deterministic and testable — can't have surprise regressions in ranking." — Maya Patel
- "Start hosted POC quickly, but if latency/costs don't meet targets we will move to Dedicated." — VP Product (Josh Rivera)

POC plan discussed:
1) Hosted API POC: QueryBoost provides eval set + candidate generation script; Redwood returns rerank scores for top-k via hosted rerank endpoint; evaluate relevance lift vs baseline.
2) Offline scoring run: test bulk scoring pricing and throughput (nightly run of 10M rows).
3) If hosted meets latency & unit-cost targets -> convert to committed Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) for predictable latency and cost.

Open questions to solve in next week:
- Concrete per-call pricing for reranking endpoint (hosted) vs Dedicated commit pricing model.
- Request exact SOC2 artifact and KMS integration guide for legal/security review.
- Confirm fallback behavior: prefer model variant fallback + region fallback for degraded capacity.

Internal notes (AE): strong fit for Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization) to reduce offline scoring cost. SE call scheduled to size Dedicated pool for 300 qps batched rerank.
